message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to buy or auction Virginia Avenue.

I have $622 cash. I own no pink properties yet. I am checking which players hold the other pinks.

St. Charles belongs to p3 and States to p4. Splitting the pink group would prevent any player from completing it. I need New York from p4 to finish the orange path. p4 is cash-poor at $444. I should not sell Vermont.

Oriental is unowned. Connecticut belongs to p2. Indiana is mine and p3 holds Illinois. Kentucky is unowned.

Buying Virginia for $160 leaves $462 cash. That is enough for a $200 rail hit. It does not complete any group for me.

Auctioning Virginia could let p3 acquire it for $1199 and complete a two-of-three pink set. That would strengthen p3's position for a Park Place trade with p4. p4 has only $444 and cannot afford to buy it.

If p3 acquires Virginia, they would trade States for Park Place. Both p3 and p4 would then hold monopolies. That outcome is harmful to me.

If I buy Virginia, I become the gatekeeper for the pink group. I can refuse to sell it to either p3 or p4, blocking both the pink monopoly and the Park Place-for-States trade that would give p4 a dark-blue set.

I will buy Virginia. I cannot auction it because the available actions are only buy_property or start_auction.
